//: House gates — deterministic, independent of superpowers. These ENFORCE rules rather than request them. Adjust matchers/commands to your stack. Verify the hook schema against current Claude Code docs at adoption time.

PostToolUse.//: Auto-lint every file the agent writes or edits, so style never drifts.

PreToolUse.//: Block destructive shell commands before they run. Exit code 2 blocks and feeds the message back to the agent. Harden this list to your real risk profile.

hooks.command: grep -Eq 'rm -rf|git push --force|git push -f|DROP TABLE' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" && { echo 'Blocked: destructive command. A human must run this.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

Stop.//: Before the agent declares a task done, type check and tests must pass. Red = not done.
